title: validate findings
description: User story under REQ-178 for DEFINE step 3 PR 8 (spec section 4 validate row, section 11.7 US-17802). `rcf define validate` reports a finding and exits non-zero for an interface kind outside the closed vocabulary, a bracketed AC prefix outside the known classes, a `tacIds` naming a non-TAC and an unresolving `ownerRef` or `deliveredBy`. Absence of an AC class marker is NOT a validate finding (decision 10): the dogfood tree and every legacy tree would otherwise fail CI; D4 reports absence as the floor.
iWant: validate to catch misuse of the four closed vocabularies (interface kind, AC class, tacIds, ownerRef / deliveredBy) at the one surface everyone runs today
soThat: a typo or a wrong vocabulary value fails fast and is not left to the gates

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] given an interface kind "widget", when validate runs, then it reports a finding and exits non-zero.
[failure] given an AC description starting "[sometimes]", when validate runs, then it reports a finding.
[happy] given the rcf-lite dogfood tree, when validate runs, then it is clean.
[must-not] given an AC with no bracketed prefix, when validate runs, then no finding is raised.
